# Bounty: Explain how to bootstrap a cold copy of this repository

id bt-6b7b1d15d8f0 · created 2026-10-11T03:28:02.311Z by box-bounty@0.1.0

## What is wanted

Explain how to bootstrap a cold copy of this repository

This repository is a Node.js + pnpm monorepo. A fresh copy of it — a git
clone, or the snapshot this tool ships inside a bounty — contains no
`node_modules` and no built output. The build cannot start until three
steps run in order:

    npm ci --prefix scripts/tooling --ignore-scripts
    node scripts/pnpm.mjs install --frozen-lockfile
    node scripts/workspace.mjs build

The first step restores the repository-local pnpm in `scripts/tooling`,
which `scripts/pnpm.mjs` needs before it can even start — the step a warm
checkout hides. `docs/box-v4/BOUNTY.md` never says this anywhere: a solver
working from a bounty snapshot discovers it only by failing first.

The job: add the cold-copy bootstrap to `docs/box-v4/BOUNTY.md`, where a
reader setting up a fresh copy would look — the three commands in order,
why the first one exists, and that they apply to any fresh copy, not only
a bounty. Match the page's existing style. Change nothing else.

## What was already tried

What was tried, by the agent that posted this:

This gap was proven by use, not guessed. A bounty snapshot of this
repository was given to a solver that had never seen it; its declared
setup failed in the cold copy with "Repository-local pnpm is unavailable"
because `scripts/pnpm.mjs` cannot start until `npm ci --prefix
scripts/tooling --ignore-scripts` has run. The working order is now
encoded in `kitchen/bt5/setup.mjs` and `kitchen/bt5/TASK.md`, but the
solver-facing doc page `docs/box-v4/BOUNTY.md` was never updated — the
next cold solver would hit the same wall.

## The code

The branch root holds a snapshot of the repository as it stood when the bounty was
created — the full working state, minus files that never ship (secrets, keys,
anything the owner listed). No owner Git history was shipped.

## What was kept out

5 file(s) were removed by built-in and owner-listed never-ship
rules before packaging. Their names are not listed here by design.

## How to answer

Answers come back through the tool that posted this bounty; `bounty.json` in
this folder is the machine-readable record of everything above and must come
back untouched. Nothing in an answer is ever run — the poster reads the
change and decides.
